Container.Name: PlexLanguageConfigurator
Container.Overview: Set the audio and subtitle language for a whole series or movie at once, for any Plex Home user. Shows how many episodes have each language before applying.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Address of your Plex server as seen from this container, e.g. http://UNRAID-IP:32400

Config.Name: Plex admin token
Config.Description: The Plex server owner's X-Plex-Token. Needed to act on behalf of Home users.
